sources: Google Maps 'Ohio Christian RV Park', read 2026-10-31

values.note: Public rates: nightly $45 30-amp, $50 50-amp; $40/$45 a night for a week or more; peak weeks $70/$75; monthly $650/$700. 'Prices may change during holidays or special events.' Which weeks are peak isn't posted. Pets $5 a night each.

hookups.source: https://www.ohiochristian.edu/rv-park ('full sewer hookups, water, 30/50 amp electric'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Call (740) 477-7806 or send the request form on the park's page; reservations are processed weekdays in office hours, so a weekend arrival must be completed by the Friday before and a holiday arrival by the last business day before it. Full payment up front. Walk-ins not permitted. A reservation runs at most one month; longer stays by case-by-case approval.

booking.source: https://www.ohiochristian.edu/rv-park ('Reservations must be made prior to check-in. Walk-ins are not permitted'), read 2026-10-31

note: University-run RV park on the north edge of the Ohio Christian University campus off Lancaster Pike, NE of Circleville (Pickaway Co); grassy pull-in sites with fire pits. Christ-centered park rules (no alcohol, tobacco or weapons; dress code; quiet hours). No tents. RVs 10+ years old must submit photos for approval. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $45 base, full hookups 50A, phone, pin, public nightly. Changed: fees high 70 -> 75 (50-amp peak week); added walk-ins never + how booking works. Site count 80 is not on the page (from imagery) and stays. Open to the public, no student or event condition.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: passes. Posted public nightly $45 30-amp / $50 50-amp, on the university's own page (2026, no year printed; read 2026-10-31). Peak weeks $70/$75, weeks not named, 'may change during holidays or special events'. Good Sam status: none stated. Gateway: Columbus 40 km. Presence: working page + phone (740) 477-7806.
GOOGLE: 'Ohio Christian RV Park' 5.0 from 4 reviews (very thin; RV Life 4* over 2). Open, phone matches.

LONG-STAY: nightly/weekly/monthly are all sold, monthly $650/$700, 'Long-term stays are reviewed and approved on a case-by-case basis'; guests over a week help maintain the site. Imagery shows few rigs on about 80 mostly empty pads, so transient-friendly; test 2 and test 4 pass on the posted public nightly rate.

RULES that could matter: 'Reservations must be made by an adult aged 21 or older'; 10-year rule, 'Any RV or camper 10 years old or older must submit photos for approval' (EKKO 2023 passes until 2033); no alcohol, tobacco, firearms or weapons on the property; dress code ('No two-piece swimsuits that expose the midriff', 'No spaghetti strap shirts'); 'No tents'. Weekend arrivals must be completed by the Friday before, since requests are processed on weekdays only.
Pin OK: on the grassy pull-in loop on the campus's NW edge. No pond or water near. Website OK.
